purpose: Debate sanctions; teach 圧力/延長/行なわ/意義/払っ/あえて/そうすると/いわば

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 経済制裁は、圧力として有効ですか？
lines.en: Are economic sanctions effective as pressure?
lines.style: student raising a sharp question, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 効果が出るまで、時間の延長が必要なこともあります。
lines.en: Time extensions are sometimes needed for effect.
lines.style: teacher answering carefully, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 制裁が行なわれている期間、どう過ごすかが課題ですね。
lines.en: How to spend the period while sanctions are conducted is the issue.
lines.style: student probing further, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 制裁自体に意義があるのか、議論があります。
lines.en: There’s debate on whether sanctions themselves have significance.
lines.style: teacher acknowledging the controversy, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 各国が、慎重に注意を払っています。
lines.en: Each country is paying careful attention.
lines.style: student observing, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: あえて立場を明確にすることも、大事です。
lines.en: Deliberately clarifying one’s stance also matters.
lines.style: teacher advising, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そうすると、誤解が減りますね。
lines.style: student following the logic, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いわば、対話の出発点になります。
lines.en: So to speak, it becomes a starting point for dialogue.
lines.style: teacher closing the thought, tone holding steady through the whole line
